findings.where: a.pill 'Get started', a.btn-primary 'Start free trial →', CTA band 'Start your free trial →'
findings.evidence: focus.json shows every stop uses the browser default 'auto 1px rgb(16,16,16)' outline. On the near-black primary buttons (#1f1a17 fill) that ring is dark-on-dark: focus/07-on.png for 'Start free trial →' shows no visible ring at all. On the dark CTA band the ring sits on the dark ground as well.
findings.after: .btn:focus-visible, .pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8552b; outline-offset: 3px } and on .cta-section use a cream ring (outline-color: #faf6ef)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible and 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (ring 3:1 against adjacent colours).

findings.evidence: Every link (nav, hero CTAs, CTA band) has href="#": activating 'Pricing', 'Docs' or 'Watch demo' scrolls to top and announces nothing; the link name promises a destination that does not exist.
findings.after: Real hrefs; 'Watch demo' as a <button> that opens a captioned video dialog, or a link to the video page
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose: the name must match where the link goes.

findings.evidence: Emoji icons are plain text in divs with no aria-hidden; screen readers announce 'high voltage', 'locked', 'chart increasing' before each card heading, adding noise that does not match the headings.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: decorative symbols should be hidden from assistive tech.

findings.evidence: Verified sweep ROB-003: at 375 the full desktop nav stays in one row (tile 375-00), pushing the page to 698px wide; 'Get started' sits off-canvas at x 615-698 and the hero is cut at the right. No menu button replaces the links. Users must scroll in two directions.
findings.after: @media (max-width: 720px) { .nav-links { display: none } } plus a <button aria-expanded> menu, keeping 'Get started' visible

findings.where: h2 'Everything you need to ship great products'
findings.evidence: The h2s ('Everything you need to ship great products', 'Ready to transform how your team builds?') describe no topic; a heading list gives a screen-reader user no idea what each section contains.
findings.before: Everything you need to ship great products
findings.after:
An h2 naming the section's subject, e.g.

Features

or the three capabilities ([DATA NEEDED])

strengths: lang and a descriptive title are set; heading levels step h1 > h2 > h3 without skips.
Body and heading contrast on cream is strong; no sweep contrast failures.

sweep Floor TYP-004 (emoji drawn by Noto Color Emoji): typographic, not an a11y failure; disputed as a11y Floor
